title: Spanish Speed Limit Sign on Rural Dirt Road, 1936 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A 1936 black and white snapshot showing a Spanish roadside speed limit sign reading 'VELOCIDAD MAXIMA 50 Km. por H.' positioned alongside a deeply rutted, unpaved dirt road. The numerals are embedded with cat's-eye style reflective studs, overlooking a sparse, hilly rural landscape. The back is stamped by Sunshine Photo Service and dated February 28, 1936.
